decisions.reason: Whisk-removal speed, simplicity, tooling, and purposes are addressed by a separate clause and already captured by the candidate's message-73 MODIFY; the bowl-clearance change adds no necessary whisk-removal state change.
The bowl-clearance decision concerns obstruction by the whisk or motor assembly and does not change spout removability or its cleaning purpose.
Bowl-removal clearance does not alter the specified stainless-steel food-contact materials.
The source decision does not change the spout's removal-or-flushing cleanability requirement.
Requiring unobstructed bowl removal does not modify the requirement that the bottom seal prevent liquid from reaching the electronics.
The candidate's message-73 requirement concerns operating height for foam quality and splash control; the separate bowl-clearance clause does not necessarily change that operating-position state.
Bowl-removal clearance does not change the existing splash targets or mitigation options; splash control is addressed independently in the source message.
The clearance requirement does not entail a change to whisk size, material, or selected head design.
Unobstructed bowl removal does not modify the required smoothness, foam consistency, or high-speed mixing quality.
The source decision does not change pour control, dispensing path, dripping, sputtering, or beverage preservation.
Bowl-removal clearance is unrelated to placard text, position, or viewing orientation.

The source adds assembly-clearance behavior for lifting the bowl but does not necessarily change bowl depth, capacity, or refill policy; duplicating the clearance constraint here would overlap the source Requirement.
